# SYNESIS_E108 — Error

## Description

ROLE HIERARCHY KIND in `field_name` (SCOPE ITEM): only valid in SCOPE ONTOLOGY.

## Severity

An **error** stops compilation: no JSON, CSV or other export is written until it is fixed. Errors local to an `EXPORT` block are reported as warnings when compiling and stop only that block in `synesis export`.

## Compiler message

```text
ROLE HIERARCHY KIND in the field `field_name` (SCOPE ITEM): roles only apply
  to SCOPE ONTOLOGY fields.
  Hierarchy adopted by the project: move the field to SCOPE ONTOLOGY.
  Hierarchy stated by the source: use a relation in the CHAIN (e.g. TIPO_DE).
```
